onboarding.title: Want Limpa Tudo to keep an eye on this for you?
onboarding.body: It can run quietly in the background with a tray icon and let you know when there's a good amount of space to reclaim. It only measures — nothing is removed until you open the app and confirm.
onboarding.later: You can change this later in Settings.
